                                ORDINANCE                                    CX^ 2^ip,

       BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

       SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago - the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached

House) District symbols and indications, as shown on Map No. 3-G, in the area bounded

by

       The alley next north of and parallel to West Cortez Street; a line 320.50
       feet west of the intersection of North Milwaukee Avenue and West Cortez
       Street as measured along the north right-of-way line of West Cortez Street
       and perpendicular thereto; West Cortez Street; and a line 344.50 feet west
       of the intersection of North Milwaukee Avenue and West Cortez Street as
       measured along the north right-of-way line of West Cortez Street and
       perpendicular thereto,


to those of an RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.


       SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its

passage and due publication.

11.   Current Use of the Propeity: The subiect propertv is improved with a three-story (with basement)
      all residential building, which presently contains a total of four (4) dwelling units. The e.xisting
      building - therefore, is non-conformins. under the current Zoning Ordinance.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is seeking a Zonins Map Amendment in order to
      bring the existing non-conformins three-story (with basement), four-unit, residential building - at
      the subiect site, into compliance under the current Zoning Ordinance, in particular, with regard to
      density (minimum lot area - MLA).

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling unit
      number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and height of
      the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC) The Applicant is seeking a Zonins Map Amendment in
      order to bring the existing non-conformins three-story (with basement), four-unit, residential
      building - at the subiect site, into compliance under the current Zoning Ordinance, in particular,
      with regard to density (minimum lot area = MLA). The Applicant is not proposing to alter or to
      expand the physical footprint or envelope of the existing building. There is. and will remain, off-
      street surface parking for three (3) vehicles, located at the rear ofthe subject property. The existing
      building is masonry in construction and measures at or under 42 feet-0 inches (approx.) in height.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or a
      financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
      change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for e.xisting Planned
      Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
      wwvv.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?
